tagline: How long will a power station run your stuff?
description: Portable power stations ranked by how long they run the things you actually plug in, with list price, weight and specs side by side.

collections.title: Best portable power stations under $500
collections.intro: Budget stations trade capacity for price. These are the models at or under $500 list price, sorted by cost per watt-hour so you can see which one gives you the most stored energy for your money.

collections.title: Best portable power stations for camping
collections.intro: For a weekend away you want enough capacity for phones, lights and a small fridge without hauling a brick. These models weigh 30 lb or less, sorted by capacity.

collections.title: Best portable power stations for home backup
collections.intro: Outage backup needs capacity and enough output to run a fridge, router and lights together. These models start at 1,000 Wh, sorted by cost per watt-hour.
